553.8g meatballs - what?!
Grandmas don’t do the numbers in our homes; I don't do a whole 872,9g of soup for them (it seems we should). My sister can’t even begin the thought to do 14kg meat in her soup for everyone on Sunday - we do what needs doing at dinner parties for the masses – or maybe it seems they just get it from my aunt who cooks so well but can make anything. (My uncle was never the dinner guest; just a bit late at our dinners and that.).
This morning’s grandmommeau was sooo yummy.
1 1. ½ oz white pepper salt. This was a generous tablespoon, so maybe I should have used a teaspoon
